scope: Training-core implementation and synthetic mechanical tests only. No library or pilot audio was read by these tests; no fitted scientific model, calibration, detector score, release verdict or accuracy result was produced.

provisional_mechanics.optimizer: PyTorch 2.8.0 AdamW, learning_rate=0.001, weight_decay=0.0001; other settings retain that implementation's defaults
provisional_mechanics.shuffle: Separate CPU torch.Generator with seed 20260927; randperm per epoch; does not consume ambient CPU RNG
provisional_mechanics.source_weighting: Equal mass per training component, equal quartets within component; each quartet has two negatives and two positives
provisional_mechanics.accumulation: One quartet forward/backward at a time, optimizer step every 16 quartets. Short final accumulation uses the same denominator of 16, is not dropped/padded, and is recorded.
provisional_mechanics.loss: Existing quartet BCE plus 0.1 squared nuisance-logit consistency, unchanged
provisional_mechanics.epochs: At most 20; no scheduler, early stop, retry, alternate seed or clipping added
provisional_mechanics.selection: File arithmetic-mean window logit before BCE; equal component weight, half per class; strict minimum source/class-balanced selection BCE; earliest epoch on ties; restore selected state only after all planned epochs succeed
provisional_mechanics.input_validation: Finite detached float32 frontend tensors, valid window counts and class labels, complete selection classes per group, no train/selection component overlap; this does not certify recording provenance or legal permission

coverage: Partition/epoch limits and cross-partition overlap rejection
Invalid labels, missing classes, malformed/nonfinite features and window counts
Component/class-balanced selection despite repeated negative cases
Accumulated gradients match independently constructed component-weighted full-batch AdamW update
Short final accumulation is counted, not silently dropped
Best state restoration and earliest-epoch tie behavior
Deterministic repeat and preservation of ambient CPU RNG
Nonfinite gradients fail before optimizer update
Actual 217201-parameter candidate optimizer step on small artificial feature tensors

native_frontend_backward_smoke.input: Analytic stereo sinusoids, deterministic perturbation and gain, not actual codec cases; four members of four seconds each
native_frontend_backward_smoke.limitation: Training/backward process high-water marks, not isolated case memory, inference RSS or the release runtime gate

minimal_environment_discovery.note: New optional research tests now explicitly skip only when their research dependencies are absent. All executed successfully in the research environment; skipped checks are not counted as passes.
